tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool chalk white, never cream.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the race card and the weekly plan.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between plan days. Decorative only: not for input borders, which use ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and faience-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, input borders; on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: faience
tokens.usage: The brand colour: primary buttons, links, the active day, progress. As text on surface, surface-raised and faience-soft.

tokens.name: faience-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind faience text: selected chips, the current week.

tokens.name: on-faience
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a faience fill.

tokens.name: faience-deep
tokens.usage: Large brand fields: the app icon ground, hero bands, the share card. Text on it is on-deep.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and the track lines on a faience-deep field.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The runner's dot: race day, the finish, one key action per screen. Fill only; text on it is on-coral. Never for errors.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a coral fill.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Medals and personal bests only. Fill only; text on it is on-sand.

tokens.name: on-sand
tokens.usage: Text on a sand fill.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the race countdown, a hero headline.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the race name on the race card.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: النهارده جري سهل 6 كم. لازم تقدر تتكلم وانت بتجري.
styles.usage: All running text. Arabic needs the tall leading; do not tighten it.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tab labels, day names.

styles.name: pace
styles.usage: Paces, split times, distances and countdown numbers. Western digits, tabular.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the side gutter; gap between plan days.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on wider screens; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the race card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips: the stadium shape of a running track.
